controls.title: Public storage access increases data exposure risk
controls.remediation_summary: Disable anonymous or public storage access and review data exposure paths.
manual_steps: Confirm whether public storage access is intentional and documented.
Disable public access for sensitive storage unless a signed exception exists.
Review exposed data paths and notify accountable business owners where required.

code.label: Review public S3 and RDS exposure
code.snippet: aws s3api list-buckets --query 'Buckets[].Name' --output table && aws rds describe-db-instances --query 'DBInstances[].{Id:DBInstanceIdentifier,Public:PubliclyAccessible}' --output table

findings.title: Public storage access increases data exposure risk

controls.title: Privileged role assignments without MFA enforcement
controls.remediation_summary: Require MFA and admin-focused conditional access for privileged identities.
manual_steps: Review all privileged role assignments and confirm each principal has a named owner.
Require MFA for privileged users and emergency access accounts through an approved policy.
Create a decision record for any exception, including expiry and compensating control.

controls.title: Activity log retention is below governance and investigation expectations
controls.remediation_summary: Increase log retention to support investigation, governance review, and evidence preservation.
manual_steps: Set an activity log retention period that matches the SME governance and incident review window.
Route important logs to a monitored workspace or archive destination.
Document retention costs and any constrained-scope exception.

code.label: Review CloudTrail and CloudWatch Logs retention
code.snippet: aws cloudtrail describe-trails --include-shadow-trails false --output table && aws logs describe-log-groups --query 'logGroups[].{Name:logGroupName,Retention:retentionInDays}' --output table

findings.title: Activity log retention is below governance and investigation expectations

controls.title: Administrative services are exposed to the public internet
controls.remediation_summary: Restrict SSH and RDP exposure with private access paths, VPN, or just-in-time controls.
manual_steps: Identify the exposed workload, rule, source range, and business owner.
Replace public administrative access with VPN, private endpoint, bastion, or just-in-time access.
Record any temporary exposure as a time-bound governance exception.
